title: Honest game review
body: This is a great game for when you and your friends are bored and want something competitive and intellectual to play. I was waiting in line for a concert and my friend and I pulled this game out and played one game and we were at the front. The auto judge is cool but playing with your own judge is a whole other level, your friends and you get into the most heated convos about who is better and reasoning and it’s fire. Love this game. Even with the pay for more modes, I would. One time payment for this is dope.
